verses.original: הֵ֤ן עַבְדִּי֙ אֶתְמָךְ־ בּ֔וֹ בְּחִירִ֖י רָצְתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י נָתַ֤תִּי רוּחִי֙ עָלָ֔יו מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לַגּוֹיִ֥ם יוֹצִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: hên ‘aḇ·dî ’eṯ·māḵ- bōw bə·ḥî·rî rā·ṣə·ṯāh nap̄·šî nā·ṯat·tî rū·ḥî ‘ā·lāw miš·pāṭ lag·gō·w·yim yō·w·ṣî
verses.literal: Here is My Servant whom I uphold My Chosen One in whom My soul delights I will put My Spirit on Him and He will bring justice to the nations
verses.literalPt: Eis o meu servo, a quem sustenho; o meu escolhido, no qual a minha alma se agrada. Tenho posto sobre ele o meu Espírito, e ele fará sair juízo às nações.

verses.original: לֹ֥א יִצְעַ֖ק וְלֹ֣א יִשָּׂ֑א וְלֹֽא־ יַשְׁמִ֥יעַ בַּח֖וּץ קוֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yiṣ·‘aq wə·lō yiś·śā wə·lō- yaš·mî·a‘ ba·ḥūṣ qō·w·lōw
verses.literal: He will not cry out or raise His voice nor make His voice heard in the streets
verses.literalPt: Não clamará, nem levantará, nem fará ouvir a sua voz na rua.

verses.original: קָנֶ֤ה רָצוּץ֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁבּ֔וֹר וּפִשְׁתָּ֥ה כֵהָ֖ה לֹ֣א יְכַבֶּ֑נָּה לֶאֱמֶ֖ת יוֹצִ֥יא מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: qā·neh rā·ṣūṣ lō yiš·bō·wr ū·p̄iš·tāh ḵê·hāh lō yə·ḵab·ben·nāh le·’ĕ·meṯ yō·w·ṣî miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: A bruised reed He will not break and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish He will faithfully bring forth justice
verses.literalPt: Não quebrará a cana rachada, nem apagará a torcida que fumega; com verdade fará sair o juízo.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִכְהֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א יָר֔וּץ עַד־ יָשִׂ֥ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּלְתוֹרָת֖וֹ אִיִּ֥ים יְיַחֵֽילוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō yiḵ·heh wə·lō yā·rūṣ ‘aḏ- yā·śîm bā·’ā·reṣ miš·pāṭ ū·lə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯōw ’î·yîm yə·ya·ḥê·lū
verses.literal: He will not grow weak . . . or discouraged before He has established justice on the earth In His law the islands will put their hope
verses.literalPt: Não se apagará, nem será quebrado, até que estabeleça o juízo na terra; e as ilhas esperarão a sua lei.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר הָאֵ֣ל׀ יְהוָ֗ה בּוֹרֵ֤א הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְנ֣וֹטֵיהֶ֔ם רֹקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ וְצֶאֱצָאֶ֑יהָ נֹתֵ֤ן נְשָׁמָה֙ לָעָ֣ם עָלֶ֔יהָ וְר֖וּחַ לַהֹלְכִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar hā·’êl Yah·weh bō·w·rê haš·šā·ma·yim wə·nō·w·ṭê·hem rō·qa‘ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’e·hā nō·ṯên nə·šā·māh lā·‘ām ‘ā·le·hā wə·rū·aḥ la·hō·lə·ḵîm bāh
verses.literal: This is what God the LORD says He who created the heavens and stretched them out who spread out the earth and its offspring who gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Deus, Jeová, que criou os céus e os estendeu; que alargou a terra e o que dela procede; aquele que dá respiração ao povo que está sobre ela e espírito aos que andam nela.

verses.original: אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה קְרָאתִ֥יךָֽ בְצֶ֖דֶק וְאַחְזֵ֣ק בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְאֶצָּרְךָ֗ וְאֶתֶּנְךָ֛ לִבְרִ֥ית עָ֖ם לְא֥וֹר גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā ḇə·ṣe·ḏeq wə·’aḥ·zêq bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·’eṣ·ṣā·rə·ḵā wə·’et·ten·ḵā liḇ·rîṯ ‘ām lə·’ō·wr gō·w·yim
verses.literal: I the LORD have called you for a righteous purpose and I will take hold of your hand I will keep you and appoint you to be a covenant for the people and a light to the nations
verses.literalPt: Eu, Jeová, te chamei em justiça, tomar-te-ei pela tua mão, conservar-te-ei e te porei para aliança do povo, para luz dos gentios,

verses.original: לִפְקֹ֖חַ עֵינַ֣יִם עִוְר֑וֹת לְהוֹצִ֤יא מִמַּסְגֵּר֙ אַסִּ֔יר מִבֵּ֥ית כֶּ֖לֶא יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lip̄·qō·aḥ ‘ê·na·yim ‘iw·rō·wṯ lə·hō·w·ṣî mim·mas·gêr ’as·sîr mib·bêṯ ke·le yō·šə·ḇê ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: to open the eyes of the blind to bring prisoners out of the dungeon and those sitting in darkness out from the prison house
verses.literalPt: a fim de abrir os olhos cegos, e de tirar da prisão os presos, e da casa do cárcere os que estão sentados nas trevas.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא שְׁמִ֑י וּכְבוֹדִי֙ לְאַחֵ֣ר לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֔ן וּתְהִלָּתִ֖י לַפְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh hū šə·mî ū·ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏî lə·’a·ḥêr lō- ’et·tên ū·ṯə·hil·lā·ṯî lap·pə·sî·lîm
verses.literal: I am the LORD that is My name I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols
verses.literalPt: Eu sou Jeová, este é o meu nome; a minha glória, não a darei a outrem, nem o meu louvor, às imagens esculpidas.

verses.original: הָרִֽאשֹׁנ֖וֹת הִנֵּה־ בָ֑אוּ וַֽחֲדָשׁוֹת֙ אֲנִ֣י מַגִּ֔יד בְּטֶ֥רֶם תִּצְמַ֖חְנָה אַשְׁמִ֥יע אֶתְכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ hin·nêh- ḇā·’ū wa·ḥă·ḏā·šō·wṯ ’ă·nî mag·gîḏ bə·ṭe·rem tiṣ·maḥ·nāh ʾaš·mīʿ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: Behold the former things have happened and now I declare new things Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you
verses.literalPt: Eis que as primeiras coisas já se realizaram, e eu vos anuncio novas coisas; antes que sucedam, eu vos farei ouvi-las.

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֔שׁ תְּהִלָּת֖וֹ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ יוֹרְדֵ֤י הַיָּם֙ וּמְלֹא֔וֹ אִיִּ֖ים וְיֹשְׁבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū Yah·weh šîr ḥā·ḏāš tə·hil·lā·ṯōw miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ yō·wr·ḏê hay·yām ū·mə·lō·’ōw ’î·yîm wə·yō·šə·ḇê·hem
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD a new song His praise from the ends of the earth you who go down to the sea and all that is in it you islands and all who dwell in them
verses.literalPt: Cantai a Jeová um cântico novo, cantai o seu louvor desde a extremidade da terra, vós os que desceis ao mar e tudo quanto há nele; vós, ilhas e os que nelas habitam.

verses.original: יִשְׂא֤וּ מִדְבָּר֙ וְעָרָ֔יו חֲצֵרִ֖ים תֵּשֵׁ֣ב קֵדָ֑ר יָרֹ֙נּוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי סֶ֔לַע מֵרֹ֥אשׁ הָרִ֖ים יִצְוָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·’ū miḏ·bār wə·‘ā·rāw ḥă·ṣê·rîm tê·šêḇ qê·ḏār yā·rōn·nū yō·šə·ḇê se·la‘ mê·rōš hā·rîm yiṣ·wā·ḥū
verses.literal: Let the desert and its cities raise their voices let the villages of Kedar cry aloud Let the people of Sela sing for joy let them cry out from the mountaintops . . .
verses.literalPt: Levantem a sua voz o deserto e suas cidades, as aldeias que habita Quedar; exultem os habitantes de Sela, clamem em alta voz do cume dos montes.

verses.original: יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לַֽיהוָ֖ה כָּב֑וֹד וּתְהִלָּת֖וֹ בָּאִיִּ֥ים יַגִּֽידוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śî·mū Yah·weh kā·ḇō·wḏ ū·ṯə·hil·lā·ṯōw bā·’î·yîm yag·gî·ḏū
verses.literal: Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands
verses.literalPt: Deem glória a Jeová e anunciem nas ilhas o seu louvor.

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ כַּגִּבּ֣וֹר יֵצֵ֔א כְּאִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמ֖וֹת יָעִ֣יר קִנְאָ֑ה יָרִ֙יעַ֙ אַף־ יַצְרִ֔יחַ עַל־ אֹיְבָ֖יו יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh kag·gib·bō·wr yê·ṣê kə·’îš mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ yā·‘îr qin·’āh yā·rî·a‘ ’ap̄- yaṣ·rî·aḥ ‘al- ’ō·yə·ḇāw yiṯ·gab·bār
verses.literal: The LORD goes forth like a mighty one He stirs up His zeal like a warrior . . . He shouts yes He roars in triumph over His enemies
verses.literalPt: Jeová sairá como valente, despertará o seu zelo como homem de guerra. Exultará, clamará em alta voz, mostrar-se-á valente contra os seus inimigos.

verses.original: הֶחֱשֵׁ֙יתִי֙ מֵֽעוֹלָ֔ם אַחֲרִ֖ישׁ אֶתְאַפָּ֑ק כַּיּוֹלֵדָ֣ה אֶפְעֶ֔ה אֶשֹּׁ֥ם וְאֶשְׁאַ֖ף יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: he·ḥĕ·šê·ṯî mê·‘ō·w·lām ’a·ḥă·rîš ’eṯ·’ap·pāq kay·yō·w·lê·ḏāh ’ep̄·‘eh ’eš·šōm wə·’eš·’ap̄ yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: I have kept silent from ages past I have remained quiet and restrained But now I will groan like a woman in labor I will at once gasp and pant
verses.literalPt: Já há muito que guardo silêncio, que me conservo quieto e que me retenho; agora, darei gritos como a que está de parto, abrirei a boca e ficarei esbaforido a um mesmo tempo.

verses.original: אַחֲרִ֤יב הָרִים֙ וּגְבָע֔וֹת וְכָל־ עֶשְׂבָּ֖ם אוֹבִ֑ישׁ וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י נְהָרוֹת֙ לָֽאִיִּ֔ים וַאֲגַמִּ֖ים אוֹבִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rîḇ hā·rîm ū·ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ wə·ḵāl ‘eś·bām ’ō·w·ḇîš wə·śam·tî nə·hā·rō·wṯ lā·’î·yîm wa·’ă·ḡam·mîm ’ō·w·ḇîš
verses.literal: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation I will turn the rivers into dry land and drain the marshes
verses.literalPt: Farei desertos os montes e outeiros e secarei toda a sua verdura; tornarei os rios em ilhas e secarei os lagos.

verses.original: וְהוֹלַכְתִּ֣י עִוְרִ֗ים בְּדֶ֙רֶךְ֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ בִּנְתִיב֥וֹת לֹֽא־ יָדְע֖וּ אַדְרִיכֵ֑ם אָשִׂים֩ מַחְשָׁ֨ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶ֜ם לָא֗וֹר וּמַֽעֲקַשִּׁים֙ לְמִישׁ֔וֹר אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים עֲשִׂיתִ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עֲזַבְתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·laḵ·tî ‘iw·rîm bə·ḏe·reḵ lō yā·ḏā·‘ū bin·ṯî·ḇō·wṯ lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ’aḏ·rî·ḵêm ’ā·śîm maḥ·šāḵ lip̄·nê·hem lā·’ō·wr ū·ma·‘ă·qaš·šîm lə·mî·šō·wr ’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ‘ă·śî·ṯim wə·lō ‘ă·zaḇ·tîm
verses.literal: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know I will guide them on unfamiliar . . . paths I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground These things I will do for them and I will not forsake them
verses.literalPt: Guiarei os cegos por um caminho que não conhecem; por veredas que lhes são desconhecidas fá-las-ei caminhar; tornarei as trevas em luz diante deles e os caminhos tortos, em direitos. Essas coisas lhes farei e não os abandonarei.

verses.original: נָסֹ֤גוּ אָחוֹר֙ יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ בֹ֔שֶׁת הַבֹּטְחִ֖ים בַּפָּ֑סֶל הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לְמַסֵּכָ֖ה אַתֶּ֥ם אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: nā·sō·ḡū ’ā·ḥō·wr yê·ḇō·šū ḇō·šeṯ hab·bō·ṭə·ḥîm bap·pā·sel hā·’ō·mə·rîm lə·mas·sê·ḵāh ’at·tem ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: But those who trust in idols and say to molten images You are our gods will be turned back in utter shame
verses.literalPt: Tornados para trás e cobertos de vergonha serão os que confiam em imagens esculpidas e dizem: Vós sois os nossos deuses.

verses.original: הַחֵרְשִׁ֖ים שְׁמָ֑עוּ וְהַעִוְרִ֖ים הַבִּ֥יטוּ לִרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥê·rə·šîm šə·mā·‘ū wə·ha·‘iw·rîm hab·bî·ṭū lir·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Listen you deaf ones look you blind ones that you may see
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, vós os que sois surdos; e olhai, vós os que sois cegos, para ver.

verses.original: מִ֤י עִוֵּר֙ כִּ֣י אִם־ עַבְדִּ֔י וְחֵרֵ֖שׁ כְּמַלְאָכִ֣י אֶשְׁלָ֑ח מִ֤י עִוֵּר֙ כִּמְשֻׁלָּ֔ם וְעִוֵּ֖ר כְּעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mî ‘iw·wêr kî ’im- ‘aḇ·dî wə·ḥê·rêš kə·mal·’ā·ḵî ’eš·lāḥ mî ‘iw·wêr kim·šul·lām wə·‘iw·wêr kə·‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Who is blind but . . . My servant or deaf like the messenger I am sending Who is blind like My covenant partner or blind like the servant of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quem é cego, senão o meu servo? Ou surdo, como o meu mensageiro que envio? Quem é cego como aquele que tem paz comigo e cego como o servo de Jeová?

verses.original: רָאִיתָ רַבּ֖וֹת וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁמֹ֑ר פָּק֥וֹחַ אָזְנַ֖יִם וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: rå̄·ʾī·ṯå̄ rab·bō·wṯ wə·lō ṯiš·mōr pā·qō·w·aḥ ’ā·zə·na·yim wə·lō yiš·mā‘
verses.literal: Though seeing many things you do not keep watch Though your ears are open you do not hear
verses.literalPt: Vês muitas coisas, porém não observas; ele tem abertos os seus ouvidos, porém não ouve.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה חָפֵ֖ץ לְמַ֣עַן צִדְק֑וֹ יַגְדִּ֥יל תּוֹרָ֖ה וְיַאְדִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ḥā·p̄êṣ lə·ma·‘an ṣiḏ·qōw yaḡ·dîl tō·w·rāh wə·ya’·dîr
verses.literal: The LORD was pleased for the sake of His righteousness to magnify His law and make it glorious
verses.literalPt: Foi do agrado de Jeová, por amor da sua justiça, engrandecer a lei e torná-la gloriosa.

verses.original: וְהוּא֮ עַם־ בָּז֣וּז וְשָׁסוּי֒ הָפֵ֤חַ בַּֽחוּרִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם וּבְבָתֵּ֥י כְלָאִ֖ים הָחְבָּ֑אוּ הָי֤וּ לָבַז֙ וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּ֔יל מְשִׁסָּ֖ה וְאֵין־ אֹמֵ֥ר הָשַֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ‘am- bā·zūz wə·šā·sui hā·p̄ê·aḥ ba·ḥū·rîm kul·lām ū·ḇə·ḇāt·tê ḵə·lā·’îm hā·ḥə·bā·’ū hā·yū lā·ḇaz wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl mə·šis·sāh wə·’ên- ’ō·mêr hā·šaḇ
verses.literal: But this is a people plundered and looted all trapped in caves or imprisoned in dungeons . . . They have become plunder with no one to rescue them and loot with no one to say Send them back
verses.literalPt: Mas este é um povo roubado e saqueado; todos eles estão enlaçados em cavernas e estão escondidos nas casas dos cárceres; são postos como presa, e ninguém os livra; como despojo, e ninguém diz: Restitui.

verses.original: מִ֥י בָכֶ֖ם יַאֲזִ֣ין זֹ֑את יַקְשִׁ֥ב וְיִשְׁמַ֖ע לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: mî ḇā·ḵem ya·’ă·zîn zōṯ yaq·šiḇ wə·yiš·ma‘ lə·’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: Who among you will pay attention to this Who will listen and obey hereafter
verses.literalPt: Quem há entre vós que dará ouvidos a isso? Que escutará e ouvirá doravante?

verses.original: מִֽי־ נָתַ֨ן לִמְשׁוֹסֶה יַעֲקֹ֛ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל לְבֹזְזִ֖ים הֲל֣וֹא יְהוָ֑ה ז֚וּ חָטָ֣אנוּ ל֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־ אָב֤וּ בִדְרָכָיו֙ הָל֔וֹךְ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּתוֹרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- nā·ṯan lim·šō·sɛh ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḇō·zə·zîm hă·lō·w Yah·weh zū ḥā·ṭā·nū lōw wə·lō- ’ā·ḇū ḇiḏ·rā·ḵāw hā·lō·wḵ wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū bə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Who gave Jacob up for spoil and Israel to the plunderers Was it not the LORD against whom we have sinned They were unwilling to walk in His ways and they would not obey His law
verses.literalPt: Quem entregou Jacó por despojo e Israel aos roubadores? Acaso, não foi Jeová? Aquele contra quem temos pecado, em cujos caminhos eles não queriam andar, e cuja lei não queriam observar.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ עָלָיו֙ חֵמָ֣ה אַפּ֔וֹ וֶעֱז֖וּז מִלְחָמָ֑ה וַתְּלַהֲטֵ֤הוּ מִסָּבִיב֙ וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֔ע וַתִּבְעַר־ בּ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ יָשִׂ֥ים עַל־ לֵֽב׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·pōḵ ‘ā·lāw ḥê·māh ’ap·pōw we·‘ĕ·zūz mil·ḥā·māh wat·tə·la·hă·ṭê·hū mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·lō yā·ḏā‘ wat·tiḇ·‘ar- bōw wə·lō- yā·śîm ‘al- lêḇ
verses.literal: So He poured out on them His furious anger and the fierceness of battle It enveloped them in flames but they did not understand it consumed them but they did not take it to heart
verses.literalPt: Portanto, Jeová derramou sobre Israel o furor da sua ira e a violência da guerra; isso lhe ateou fogo ao redor; contudo, ele não percebeu; e o queimou; contudo, ele não entendeu.
